index.value: S&P 500 (BlackRock: S&P 500 Net TR Index (AUD)), unhedged

yield.note: BlackRock's '12m Trailing Yield' at 30 Sep 2026 (IVV fact sheet, September 2026): distributions paid over the past 12 months as a % of the unit price. Those 12 months happened to include five quarterly distributions (ex-dates 3 Oct 2025 to 29 Sep 2026); the latest four come to about 1.0% of the price, which is closer to a normal year.

franking.note: Not stated by BlackRock; US shares carry no franking credits

listed.note: First day of trading on the ASX (ASX company listing date). Daily prices start here.

inception.note: ASX listing date (cross-listing of the US fund, which started 15 May 2000). Became an Australian-domiciled fund on 7 Sep 2018; 15-for-1 unit split in early Dec 2022.
